summary: The strip has no pops, flicker or clipping, but the dancer is small and far off, and his head sits against the top edge of the frame while a blurry candelabra dominates the foreground.

faults.what: The dancer is tiny at the far end of the table, and a large blurry candelabra and goblets in the foreground take the eye. The subject is not clear and the joke of him dancing on the table barely reads.
faults.fix: Move the camera closer or lower to the dancer, or shift the framing so the foreground props don't cover the lower half of the frame.

faults.what: His head sits at the very top edge of the frame in the first tiles. There is no headroom, and he is nearly cropped through the 79.53 tile.
faults.fix: Tilt the camera up slightly or lower the frame so there is headroom above him.
